why_projection: Raw cell labels are disjoint across granularities by construction (coarse keys are parent paths, fine keys carry a place suffix), so raw-label RBO is identically zero and measures the labelling scheme rather than the triage. The pre-registered criterion is therefore evaluated on lists projected onto the shared archival referent (depth-2 topic path). Both are reported.
